references.summary: Cool-season leafy vegetable with heading and loose-leaf types. Frost response varies with cultivar, hardening and head stage. High temperature can inhibit germination and promote bolting or poor quality; these are different endpoints. Rotation can reduce some soil-borne disease risks; lettuce pathogens vary in host range and persistence. Transplant-to-harvest, baby-leaf harvest and full-head maturity describe different crop calendars.
